title: Successful optical genome mapping from 500,000 cells: A low-input UHMW DNA extraction approach
author: De Vlieghere, Nollet, et al.
materials: 1. Preparation•Cold Stabilizing Buffer (CSB):Prepare fresh and keep on ice. For 1 mL of CSB, mix:○20 µL DNA Stabilizer (Bionano, 20469)○980 µL Cell Buffer (Bionano, 20372)•Lysis & Digestion Cocktail:For 1 sample, prepare just before use:○270 µL Digestion Enhancer (Bionano, 20457)○66.25 µL Ultrapure Water (Bionano, 20532)○Appropriate volumes of:■Lysis and Binding Buffer (Bionano, 20372)■DE Detergent (Bionano, 20461)■Thermolabile Proteinase K (Bionano, 20456) – add immediately before use

6. Cell Lysis•Add 20 µL of cold CSB. Mix gently by pipetting 5 times in a slow, rotating motion.•Add 430 µL of Lysis & Digestion Cocktail. Invert the tube 15 times. Incubate on the HulaMixer (ThermoFisher, 15920D) at 10 rpm, 15 min, RT.•Pulse spin briefly and incubate at 55 °C for 10 min.•Only for magnetic bead–selected cells:○Remove magnetic beads using the DynaMag (ThermoFisher, 1231D) for 10 min.○The beads will adhere to the magnet. Carefully transfer the supernatant (containing the cells) to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Bionano, 20540).

8. Washing the Nanobind Disk•Use the DynaMag (ThermoFisher, 1231D) to remove all liquid.•Add 700 µL Wash Buffer 1 (Bionano, 20458). Mix on HulaMixer at 10 rpm, 1 min, RT.•Repeat the previous steps one more time.•After final removal of Wash Buffer 1, add 500 µL Wash Buffer 2 (Bionano, 20460).•Mix on HulaMixer at 10 rpm, 1 min, RT and remove liquid using the DynaMag (Thermofisher, 1231D).

11. Measurement of gDNA Concentration•Measure the gDNA concentration using the Qubit™ dsDNA Broad Range Assay Kit (ThermoFisher, Q32850).•Perform measurements in triplicate. If the elution buffer volume used is <55 µL, measure in duplicate.•The expected gDNA concentration should be between 36 and 250 ng/µL, with a coefficient of variation (CV) < 0.3.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and cocktail
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh cold stabilizing buffer (CSB) on ice: for 1 mL mix 20 µL DNA Stabilizer (Bionano 20469) with 980 µL Cell Buffer (Bionano 20372). Immediately before use, prepare the Lysis & Digestion Cocktail for each sample by mixing 270 µL Digestion Enhancer (Bionano 20457), 66.25 µL ultrapure water (Bionano 20532) and the appropriate volumes of Lysis and Binding Buffer (Bionano 20372), DE Detergent (Bionano 20461) and Thermolabile Proteinase K (Bionano 20456); add Proteinase K just before use.

steps.title: Defrost and process samples
steps.instruction: For bone‑marrow aspirate (BMA): incubate at 37 °C for 2 min, immediately place on ice, invert tube 10 times and perform a quick pulse spin. For cell suspensions (e.g., CD138⁺ or biopsy‑derived): thaw at 37 °C, monitor closely, then centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at room temperature (RT); remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL cold CSB.

steps.title: Filter bone marrow aspirate
steps.instruction: Pipette up to 500 µL of the BMA onto a BMA Filter (Bionano 20464) placed in a 2 mL collection tube (Bionano 20452), centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at RT, then resuspend the filtered cells in cell buffer.

steps.title: Count and dilute WBCs
steps.instruction: Determine white‑blood‑cell concentration with the HemoCue WBC system; if the concentration exceeds 30 × 10⁶ cells/mL, dilute the sample with Cell Buffer (Bionano 20372) accordingly.

steps.title: Transfer cells and pretreat
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.5 × 10⁶ cells to a pre‑cooled 1.5 mL Protein LoBind tube (Bionano 20540) (if fewer cells are available, transfer all). For BMA samples only, add RBC Lysis Buffer (Bionano 20442) at three times the sample volume, invert 10 times, incubate at RT for 5 min, invert another 10 times, centrifuge at 2200 × g for 2 min at RT, then carefully remove supernatant leaving 40 µL in the tube.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL cold CSB and mix gently by pipetting 5 times in a slow rotating motion. Add 430 µL Lysis & Digestion Cocktail, invert 15 times, then incubate on a HulaMixer (ThermoFisher 15920D) at 10 rpm for 15 min at RT. Pulse‑spin briefly and incubate at 55 °C for 10 min. If magnetic‑bead‑selected cells are used, place the tube on a DynaMag (ThermoFisher 1231D) for 10 min, allow beads to adhere, and transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube (Bionano 20540).

steps.title: Bind DNA to Nanobind Disk
steps.instruction: Add a Nanobind Disk (Bionano 20539) to the lysed sample, add 480 µL 100 % isopropanol, invert 5 times, then place on the HulaMixer at 10 rpm for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Wash Nanobind Disk
steps.instruction: Using the DynaMag (ThermoFisher 1231D), remove all liquid. Add 700 µL Wash Buffer 1 (Bionano 20458), mix on the HulaMixer at 10 rpm for 1 min at RT, then remove liquid; repeat this Wash Buffer 1 step once more. After the final removal, add 500 µL Wash Buffer 2 (Bionano 20460), mix at 10 rpm for 1 min at RT and remove the liquid with the DynaMag.

steps.title: Elute gDNA (adapted)
steps.instruction: If the WBC count from step 5a was > 1.2 × 10⁶, transfer the Nanobind Disk with a magnetic retriever to a 0.5 mL Protein LoBind tube (Bionano 20541); if < 1.2 × 10⁶, transfer the disk to a U‑shaped non‑binding well plate (Greiner Bio‑One 650901). Spin down and remove all residual liquid. Add Elution Buffer (Bionano 20463) in a volume that corresponds to the number of cells transferred in step 5a (see Fig 2). Ensure the disk lies horizontally and is fully immersed. Incubate 20 min at RT to elute DNA. Transfer the viscous eluate to a 2 mL Protein LoBind tube (Bionano 20542), perform a short spin of the original tube/plate to collect any remaining liquid, and add this residual volume to the same 2 mL tube. Repeat the collection if necessary to maximize recovery.

steps.title: Shear gDNA by pipetting
steps.instruction: Set the pipette to the same volume as the elution buffer used in step 9, gently pipette the gDNA up and down six times in a slow circular motion, briefly spin down, then incubate the sample overnight or over the weekend at RT in a light‑protected box.

steps.title: Quantify gDNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure gDNA concentration with the Qubit™ dsDNA Broad Range Assay Kit (ThermoFisher Q32850). Perform measurements in triplicate; if the elution buffer volume used was < 55 µL, measure in duplicate. Expected concentration: 36–250 ng/µL with a coefficient of variation (CV) < 0.3.

description: The procedures are performed according to the manufacturer's protocol (Bionano) [[1], [2]]. However, Step 9-Elution of gDNA- was customized to enable the isolation of high-quality UHMW gDNA from a limited number of cells (Fig. 1). When using the standard protocol with low-input samples, the resulting gDNA concentration is often insufficient for successful OGM analysis.Fig. 1Schematic overview of the DNA isolation protocol, highlighting the adaptation made during the elution step.Fig 1 Our modification to the elution step (highlighted in bold) ensures both a sufficient gDNA concentration and high molecular weight integrity. This adaptation enables reliable and high-quality OGM even when starting with a limited cell count.
